headline: Analysts at Jefferies expect Alibaba's AI cloud revenue to grow more than 50% in the September quarter, faster than most analysts predict.
score_reason: Keeps the pool score: a single bank's forecast ahead of results; the original SCMP report could not be opened.
importance_line: Alibaba's investors and cloud customers get an early signal on China's AI cloud demand, but this is one bank's forecast, not Alibaba's results.
summary: Proactive reports, as carried by Yahoo Finance, that Jefferies forecasts Alibaba's AI cloud and computing revenue will rise more than 50% year on year to 60.5 billion yuan in the September quarter, ahead of the 48% consensus. Jefferies kept its Buy rating on Alibaba and expects cloud growth to speed up in the next two quarters.
notes: SCMP page blocked (403). The Proactive report (via Yahoo Finance) on the Jefferies preview of the same results was used; SCMP may have quoted other analysts too, which we could not check. A forecast, not reported results.
